ActorTalk: What took you so long, 【kuroname】?
C'mon, it wasn't that long.
Haha, I'm just messing with you.
I know you're busy most of the time. Don't pay it any mind, I was just teasing.
Anyway, let's get back to the match. We'll do the same as before and use this training room's simulation equipment.
As for the forces for the two sides... since the system is under maintenance, the only data that matches your battle habits is the Pyroath frame.
Sounds good to me.
Simulation data?
That's right, we'll be using data to generate projections for battle. After all, we can't exactly bring the real thing here—Lucia would blow this training room to smithereens.
And in turn, I'll be using a joint force composed of Corrupted and mechanoids.
You're not deploying any Constructs?
Ganging up on a single person?
I just told you, the system is under maintenance... Besides, do you really think numbers would make a difference against the Pyroath frame?
So... you've got nothing but elites on your side?
About half of them are, I'd say. Oh, actually, should we add another wager before we start?
That will work.
What wager?
The winner gets to make one demand of the loser. Don't worry, I won't ask for anything too unreasonable after I win.
...I'm pretty sure you've already won.
Don't be so sure yet.
Haha, alright, we'll leave it at that then. I'll start up the simulation device now.
It's been a while but... Let's settle this, Chief.
